Paragraph: "Look at the mountain peaks covered in flowering trees; they resemble clouds painted with rainbow hues..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Contemplating the grand, colorful vistas of mountain peaks.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama uses vivid metaphors to capture the majestic scale of nature.
Outcome/Resolution: He experiences a moment of awe and perspective.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Awe Experience, Broadening Horizon, Visual Reframing

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Viraat-Rupa (Glimpse of cosmic, grand beauty in nature)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The grand mountain vistas offer a glimpse of cosmic grandeur, elevating the mind above individual suffering.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Experiencing awe through grand landscapes to help reduce the acute weight of personal distress.
